scope: W06 server identity core and actual local request store integration
verified: Service-only getters deny browser roles. Real issue/get/complete RPC arguments and DTOs match JS core/store adapter. Different session of same user denied before provider lookup, exact request completes RECORDED:1, replay denied, policy change during provider lookup leaves request pending. Core independently validates session UUID and same-session binding.
limitations: Provider is synthetic, Auth session table is a minimal fixture and RPC transport is local psql. No HTTP entry, actual token verification, provider contract, guardian relationship, consent, adult access or policy evaluation. No claim of hosted Supabase/PostgREST pass.
migrationAndRollback: Candidate outside formal migrations; disposable DB stopped after runner. No remote schema, settings, paid service, dependency or deployment changes. Remove local modules/prototype to revert.
privacy: Raw identity facts never returned by the server core or stored in request ledger. Service client must remain server-only; future HTTP adapter must derive identity/session from verified tokens.
next: Implement the authenticated server entry with explicit token verification, bounded requests and default-disabled configuration before connecting a provider.
